Role Title: Inpatient Care Physician (MD/DO)

•
Role Type: Contractor

•
Location: United States (Remote)

Engaging experienced Inpatient Care Physicians (MD/DO) to contribute specialized medical expertise to a forward-thinking AI project aimed at enhancing clinical documentation and decision support tools. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Scope of Work

• Review and assess medical records, including FHIR data and clinical notes, for use in AI training and development.

• Evaluate clinical information and ensure that all claims and statements are supported by proper documentation.

• Analyze inpatient documentation such as HPI, PMH, assessments, and care plans, identifying any discrepancies or omissions.

• Apply consistent standards and follow clear guidelines to ensure accuracy and reliability in clinical data review.

• Provide detailed, actionable feedback to project teams to improve AI model performance and data quality.

• Communicate findings and insights clearly through both written reports and verbal discussions with project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• MD or DO credential, board certified in Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, or Hospital Medicine.

• Current or recent hands-on inpatient or hospitalist clinical experience (within the past 2 years preferred).

• Expertise in patient assessment, diagnosis, and hospital-based clinical care workflows.

• Proven ability to review and critique clinical notes and raw health record data with strong attention to detail.

• Experience with chart review, clinical documentation improvement, utilization review, or medical coding/QA is advantageous.

• Demonstrated clinical reasoning and decision-making skills relevant to inpatient care.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a commitment to clear, constructive feedback.

A very attractive and competitive package is offered.
